$comment: The answer pages (CLAUDE.md, build order step 11): a page for each brand and each model with at least `minimum` vehicles first registered in the last `window` months, and an index of them. They are worked out when the site is built, from the files in public/data (src/lib/answerPages.ts, drawn by src/components/AnswerPage.astro), and ship no script. Each page answers one question, the title: how many vehicles of the brand or model were first registered in the last `window` months; it says so in a sentence, sets the figure beside the same months a year earlier and the newest month beside the same month a year earlier, says its place and its share where the published counts allow it, and holds one table or two and a link that opens the same question in the canvas. `dataset` is the dataset every figure is read from: true registrations, never the survivors dataset, and the two are never in one table. `measure` is the measure the canvas link counts. To point the pages at another dataset, change `dataset` and nothing else. `brand` and `model` each name the field the pages are made for (`dimension`), the first part of the page's address (`path`: the pages are at /<path>/<slug>/, and the slug is made from the value by src/lib/answerSlug.ts), and the least vehicles in `window` months a value needs to have a page (`minimum`). `models_listed` is how many of a brand's models its page lists, most registered first, with the rest in one line; `months_shown` is how many of the latest months the month-by-month table lists. `index_path` is the address of the index. `description_length` is the fewest and most characters a page's description may have (scripts/check-page-metadata.mjs holds the built pages to the same): a description that does not fit is replaced by the shorter one, and a page that has none that fits is not built. `definition` is where the page says what it counts, on the method page; tests/site/answer-pages.test.ts holds the anchor to a heading that exists. A change on a year ago is withheld where the earlier figure has fewer vehicles than the change floor in config/measures.json (the yoy measure), where it is missing, where a count is hidden, or where an event that changed how the data is recorded lies between the two periods (CLAUDE.md invariant 7). A count the build hides is never read as zero: a value with a hidden count in its window has no page, and a place is not stated while any count in the ranking is hidden. A place is not stated for a value level with another. A model is ranked among the models the build names, which are the most registered in the last 12 months (config/dimensions.json, the model cap), so its place among them is exact. Every text under `words` is a template held to config/narrative/rules.json (kind answer_pages) by pipeline/tests/test_site_config.py: it names no figure, year or value of a field, says what the data shows and never why, and is dropped where it cannot be filled. The words of a brand or model page that name the window use `span` for its number of months. `view_field` is the field whose values the vehicles are counted under (new or used): each page says its figure by them, beside the big figure and in a sentence, ranks the brand or model among those with vehicles of each value (a model only above the fewest vehicles any model the build names has, below which a model grouped as other may have more), shows each month by them, and a brand page lists its models once for each value and once for all behind a switch that needs no script (src/components/ViewSwitch.astro). The figures are cut from the fact table (src/lib/conditionViewsBuild.ts) and used only where they agree with the field's slice; a second link opens the same question split by the field.
